name: Forged by the Golden Melody
passiveDesc: Every 10s, the equipping character plays a "Harmonic Movement" of the corresponding type for a boost in the following order: +18/22.5/27/31.5/36% ATK > +120/150/180/210/240 Elemental Mastery > +28/35/42/49/56% Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG. Each instance of Harmonic Movement lasts 10s. This effect can trigger even when the equipping character is not on the field. Triggering a Stellar Glimmer reaction will also grant an additional 12-second instance of "Harmonic Movement: Contrapuntal" with the same effects as the Harmonic Movement active when Stellar Glimmer is triggered. This effect stacks with the original Harmonic Movement effect, and can trigger once every 12s.
description: A greatsword decorated in gold. Legend has it that it was the favored weapon of a certain exalted Harmost back in the distant past.
